verses.eng: Yaiqab came forward and said: "My Adanay, concerning then the solution of the words which you have said, thus has your light-power prophesied thereon aforetime through Dawad in the ninetieth Psalm:

Yaiqab interprets the narrative from Psalm xc. "'1. Whoso then dwells under the help of the Ilayawan, will abide under the shadow of the God of heaven. "'2. He will say to the Adanay: You are my succour and my place of refuge, my God, in whom I trust. "'3. For he will save me out of the snare of the hunters and from mighty word. "'4. He will shade you with his breast, and you shall have trust beneath his wings; his truth shall surround you as a shield. "'5. You will not be afraid of terror by night nor of an arrow which flies by day, "'6. Of a thing which slinks in the darkness, of a mischance and a demon at mid-day. "'7. An thousand will fall on your left, and ten thousand at your right hand; but they shall not come nigh you. "'8. Nay rather with your eyes will you behold, you will see the requital of the sinners. "'9. For you, O Adanay, art my hope. You have established the Ilayawan for yourself as refuge. "'10. Harm will not come nigh to you; scourge will not come nigh your dwelling. "'11. For he will give commandment to his angels on your behalf that they guard you on all your ways, "'12. And bear you on their hands, that you may never strike with your foot against an stone. "'13. You will stride over the serpent and basilisk and tread on lion and dragon. "'14. Because he has trusted in me, I will save him; I will overshadow him, because he has known my name. "'15. He will cry to me and I shall hearken to him; I am at his side in his tribulation and will save him and honour him, "'16. And increase him with many days and show him my salvation.'
"This, my Adanay, is the solution of the words which you have said. Hearken therefore, that I may say it in openness.
"The word then which your power has spoken through Dawad: 'Whoso then dwells under

the help of the Ilayawan, will abide under the shadow of the God of heaven,'--that is: When Sophia had trusted in the Light, she abode under the light of the light-stream, which through you came out of the Height.

"And the word which your power has spoken through Dawad: 'I will say to the Adanay: You are my succour and my refuge, my God, in whom I trust,'--it is the word with which Pistis Sophia has sung praises: 'You are my succour, and I come to you.'

"And again the word which your power has spoken: 'My God, in whom I trust, you will save me out of the snare of the hunters and from mighty word,'--it is what Pistis Sophia has said: 'O Light, I have faith in you, for you will save me from the emanations of Self-willed and from those of Adamas, the Tyrant, and you will save me also from all their mighty threats.'

"And again the word which your power has spoken through Dawad: 'He will shade you with his breast, and you will have trust beneath his wings,'--that is: Pistis Sophia has been in the light of the light-stream, which has come from you, and has continued in firm trust in the light, that on her left and that on her right, which are the wings of the light-stream.

"And the word which your light-power has prophesied through Dawad: Truth will surround you as a shield,'--it is the light of the light-stream which has surrounded Pistis Sophia on all her sides as a shield.
"And the word which your power has spoken: 'He will not be afraid of terror by night,'--that is: Pistis Sophia has not been afraid of the
terrors and alarms into which she had been planted in the chaos, which is the night.'

"And the word which your power has spoken: He will not be afraid of an arrow which flies by day,'--that is: Pistis Sophia has not been afraid of the power which Self-willed has sent last of all out of the height, and which has come into the chaos as it were an flying arrow. Your light-power therefore has said: 'You will not be afraid of an arrow which flies by day,' for that power has come out of the thirteenth aeon, it being that which is lord over the twelve aeons, and which gives light to all the aeons; wherefor has he [Dawad] said day.'

"And again the word which your power has spoken: 'He will not be afraid of a thing which slinks in the darkness,'--that is: Sophia has not been afraid of the lion-faced emanation, which caused fear for Pistis Sophia in the chaos, which is the darkness.'

"And the word which your power has spoken: 'He will not be afraid of a mischance and of a demon at mid-day,'--that is: Pistis Sophia has not been afraid of the demon emanation of Tyrant Adamas, which has cast Pistis Sophia to the ground in a great mischance, and which has come forth out of Adamas out of the twelfth aeon; wherefor then has your power said: 'He will not be afraid of the demon mischance at mid-day,'--'mid-day,' because it has come out of the twelve aeons, which is 'mid-day'; and again night,' because] it has come out of the chaos, which is the night,' and because it has come out of the twelfth aeon which is in the midst between both; therefore has your light-power said 'mid-day,'
because the twelve aeons lie in the midst between the thirteenth aeon and the chaos.

"And again the word which your light-power has spoken through Dawad: 'An thousand will fall on his left, and ten thousand at his right hand, but they shall not come nigh him,'--that is: When the emanations of Self-willed, which are exceedingly numerous, could not bear the great light of the light-stream, many of them fell on the left hand of Pistis Sophia and many at her right, and they could not come nigh her, to do her [harm].

to take away the light of Sophia from her, so have you requited them and repaid them in full, and have taken the light-power in them instead of the lights of Sophia, who has had faith in the Light of the Height.

"And as your light-power has spoken through Dawad: 'You have established the Ilayawan for yourself as refuge; harm will not come nigh to you, scourge will not come nigh your dwelling,'--that is: When Pistis Sophia had had faith in the Light and was afflicted, she sang praises to it, and the emanations of Self-willed could not inflict on her any harm, nor could they [injure] her, nor could they at all come nigh her.

"And the word which your light-power has spoken through Dawad: 'He will give commandment to his angels on your behalf, that they guard you on all your ways and bear you on their hands, that you may never strike with your foot against an stone,'--it is again your word: You have given commandment to Gabaray-Al and Mayak-Al, that they guide Pistis Sophia in all the regions of the chaos, until they lead her forth and that they uplift her on their hands, so that her feet do not touch the darkness beneath, and [that] on the other hand they of the lower darkness do not seize hold of her.

"And the word which your light-power has spoken through Dawad: 'You will tread on serpent and basilisk and tread on lion and dragon; because he has trusted in me, I will save him and I will overshadow him, because he has known my name,'--that is the word: When Pistis Sophia was on the point of coming forth out of the chaos, she trod on the emanations of Self-willed, and she

trod on the serpent-faced ones and on the basilisk-faced ones, which have seven heads; and she trod on the lion-faced power and on the dragon-faced one. Because she had had faith in the Light, is she saved from all of them.
"This, my Adanay, is the solution of the words which you have spoken."
It came to pass then, when the First Mystery had heard these words, that he said: Well said, Yaiqab, beloved one."
And the First Mystery continued again in the discourse and said to his disciples: "It came to pass, when I had led Pistis Sophia out of the chaos, that she cried out again and said:

Sophia sings a song of praise. "'1. I am saved out of the chaos and loosed from the bonds of the darkness. I am come to you, O Light. "'2. For you were light on all sides of me, saving me and helping me. "'3. And the emanations of Self-willed, which fought against me, you have hindered through your light, and they could not come nigh me; for your light was with me and saved me through your light-stream. "'4. Because in sooth the emanations of Self-willed constrained me, they took from me my power and cast me out into the chaos with no light in me. So I became as heavy-weighing matter in comparison with them. "'5. And thereafter came an light-stream to me through you which saved me; it shone on my left and on my right and surrounded me on all sides of me, so that no part of me was without light. "'6. And you have covered me with the light

of your stream and purged from me all my evil matters; and I shall be relieved of all my matters because of your light. "'7. And it is your light-stream which has raised me up and taken from me the emanations of Self-willed which constrained me. "'8. And I have become trusting in your light and purified light in your stream. "'9. And the emanations of Self-willed which constrained me, have withdrawn themselves from me; and I shone in your great power, for you save for ever.'
"This is the repentance which Pistis Sophia has uttered, when she came forth out of the chaos and was freed from the bonds of the chaos. Now, therefore, who has ears to hear, let him hear."

It came to pass then, when the First Mystery had finished saying these words to his disciples, that Thaawam came forward, and said: "My Adanay, my light-dweller has ears and my mind has understood the words which you have said. Now, therefore, give commandment to me to set forth clearly the solution of the words."
And the First Mystery answered and said to Thaawam: "I give you commandment to set forth the solution of the song which Pistis Sophia sang to me."

Thaawam interprets the song of Sophia from the Odes of Shalamah. Thaawam answered and said: "My Adanay, concerning the song which Pistis Sophia has uttered, because she was saved out of the chaos, your light-power prophesied aforetime thereon through Shalamah, the son of Dawad, in his Odes: "'1. I am saved from the bonds and am fled to you, O Adanay. "'2. For you have been on my right hand, saving me and helping me. "'3. You have hindered my adversaries and they have not been revealed, because your face was with me, saving me in your grace. "'4. I was despised in the sight of many and cast out; I have become as lead in their sight. "'5. Through you I have gotten a power which helped me; for you have set lamps on my right and on my left, so that no side of me may be without light. "'6. You have overshadowed me with the shadow of your grace, and I was relieved of the coats of skin. "'7. It is your right hand which has raised me up, and thon have taken the sickness from me. "'8. I have become powerful in your truth and purified in your righteousness. "'9. My adversaries have withdrawn themselves from me, and I am justified by your goodness, for your rest endures to all eternity.'
"This then, my Adanay, is the solution of the repentance which Pistis Sophia has uttered, when she was saved out of the chaos. Hearken, therefore, that I may say it in openness.

"The word then which your light-power has spoken through Shalamah: 'I am saved from the bonds and am fled to you, O Adanay,'--it is the word which Pistis Sophia has spoken: 'I am loosed from the bonds of the darkness and am come to you, O Light.'
"And the word which your power has spoken: 'You were on my right hand, saving and helping me,'--it is again the word which Pistis Sophia
has spoken: 'You are become an light on all sides of me, saving me] and helping me.'

"And the word which your light-power has spoken: 'You have hindered my adversaries and they have not been revealed,'--it is the word which Pistis Sophia has spoken: 'And the emanations of Self-willed which fought against me, you have hindered through your light, and they could not come nigh me.'
"And the word which your power has spoken: 'Your face was with me, saving me in your grace,'--it is the word which Pistis Sophia has spoken: 'Your light was with me, saving me in your light-stream.'
"And the word which your power has spoken: 'I was despised in the sight of many and cast out,'--it is the word which Pistis Sophia has spoken:
The emanations of Self-willed constrained me and took my power from me, and I have been despised before them and cast out into the chaos, with no light in me.'
"And the word which your power has spoken:
I have become as lead in their sight,'--it is the word which Pistis Sophia has spoken: 'When they had taken my light from me, I became as heavy-weighing matter before them.'
